_about: Sitting members in every House contest 1993-2025 (extract-incumbency.mjs). years[year][division] = { sit: [per res-<year> candidate, ballot order: 1 sitting member for this division (or its renamed/abolished predecessor, or a by-election winner here), 2 an MP who moved here from a division that still exists, 0 not an MP], prevWinner: previous general election's winner of the same-named division (surname), prevWinnerStood: 1 if that person stood again anywhere at this election }. Sitting = the member for that division at dissolution re-contesting it (AEC SittingMemberFl/HistoricElected where published; derived from the previous winners plus by-elections for 1993, 1998 and 2004).
